policy: A published value is admitted only with a source whose title, publisher and URL are recorded here and copied into the card.
A value that no public source states is an engineering estimate: the card carries basis 'assumed', the estimate method, and a non-zero uncertainty. No value is chosen from an engagement outcome.
Seeker mode, warhead kind, fuze arrangement and motor type are identity facts, checked against public descriptions rather than inferred from simulation behaviour.
Gimbal and launch field of view are the missile's published off-boresight capability where a source states it. A seeker that cannot be cued that far is a modelling defect, not a tuning choice.

navair-aim9x.title: AIM-9X Sidewinder
navair-aim9x.publisher: U.S. Navy, Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR)
navair-aim9x.note: Manufacturer/service description of the imaging infrared seeker and high off-boresight capability.

odin-aim9.title: AIM-9 Sidewinder, Worldwide Equipment Guide

odin-aim9.note: States up to 90 degrees off-boresight for the AIM-9X.

roe-r73e.title: R-73E air-to-air guided missile
roe-r73e.note: Manufacturer catalogue: off-boresight angles of plus/minus 45 degrees, line-of-sight rates up to 60 degrees per second.

mbda-mica.title: MICA family

deagel-iris-t.title: IRIS-T

hushkit-sraam.title: Ten best air-to-air missiles (short range)

twz-china-aam.title: A Guide To China's Increasingly Impressive Air-To-Air Missile Inventory
twz-china-aam.note: Secondary reference: PL-10 imaging infrared seeker, reportedly 90 degree off-boresight capability.
